description: This file implements a centralized module for repositioning subtitles (SRT, ASS, SSA, VTT). It provides functions to parse subtitle files, adjust their dialogue line positions based on detection results (top/bottom), and write updated subtitle files. The module emphasizes that detection and precomputing detection results are handled externally, and this code strictly reuses provided results for repositioning.
